metadata.description: Publishes a version of the certsync agent as an Azure Compute Gallery VM Application. Built as a template rather than an 'az sig gallery-application version create' call because the CLI mangles the quoting in the manage-action strings. See docs/vm-application.md.
Name of the existing Azure Compute Gallery.
Name of the existing gallery application. The downloaded package is named after this with no extension, so the install command renames it before running.
Semantic version, e.g. 1.0.0. Never reuse a published version.
Readable URL of the built certsync-extension.ps1. A read SAS is required unless the storage account allows public blob access.
Short name of the Key Vault, e.g. kv-contoso-certs.
Certificate object name in the vault, e.g. contoso-com.
Role to bind. Auto detects AD FS, WAP or IIS.
Which IIS https bindings may be re-pointed. Ignored for non-IIS roles.
Optional comma-separated IIS site names to restrict binding updates to.
How often the scheduled task runs.
Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Set this on any VM carrying more than one identity.
Scheduled task name. Must match what the remove command unregisters.
Regions to replicate to, as objects with name / regionalReplicaCount / storageAccountType. Defaults to the deployment region only.

variables.commentRename: A VM Application is delivered to the VM as a file named exactly after the application, with no extension. PowerShell will not execute an extensionless file, so it is renamed first. cmd.exe runs the manage actions, hence '&' rather than ';'.
variables.installCommand: [concat('rename ', parameters('applicationName'), ' ', parameters('applicationName'), '.ps1 & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\', parameters('applicationName'), '.ps1 -VaultName ', parameters('vaultName'), ' -CertificateName ', parameters('certificateName'), ' -Role ', parameters('role'), ' -IisBindingScope ', parameters('iisBindingScope'), ' -IntervalHours ', string(parameters('intervalHours')), ' -CleanupMode ', parameters('cleanupMode'), variables('optionalArgs'))]
